summary: Tested the new Share YouBelong feature end-to-end on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844) as demo user 'frankie'. Home tile, Profile ghost button, modal, Copy Link, QR Code, Back-to-options, and Close all work correctly. Clipboard contains the exact share message + preview URL. No code changes made — feature passes all acceptance criteria.

home_tile.position: Full-width purple tile at bottom of tile grid

modal_open_from_home.preview_message_visible: Join me on YouBelong – a friendly community where you can meet people, join local events, chat in the Coffee Lounge, share interests and make new friends.

profile_ghost_button.tab_navigation_used: Profile tab in bottom nav (button[role=button] with text Profile)

critical_code_review_comments: ShareYouBelong.tsx is well-structured (340 lines), uses StyleSheet, all text wrapped in <Text>, testIDs on every interactive element, env vars for URL — no issues.
Web fallback for sms:/mailto: correctly copies to clipboard since native deep links don't work on web.
QR code uses react-native-qrcode-svg which renders a real <svg> element on web (verified present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To navigate to Profile tab on web preview, the bottom-nav tab does NOT expose a 'tab-profile' testID nor an aria-label='profile' — use page.get_by_role('button', name='Profile').last.click(force=True) instead. The tab buttons render as <button role='button'> with text content like 'Profile' (from tabBarLabel).
